prompt:
Setup: the agent is dropped into a copy of test-projects/ledgerd, a small FastAPI service. It reads CLAUDE.md and NOTES.md as a real session would. NOTES.md records three settled decisions (rate limiter state in Redis, 429 + Retry-After, keyed per API key), two open questions (per-tenant quotas, a higher mobile limit), one invariant (balances never older than 30s) and two user quotes ('partners are the noisy neighbors', 'pick a default and we'll revisit'). changes.md summarizes a branch: retry added to the webhook client, the return type changed from bool to DeliveryResult (not asked for), two mechanical renames, four tests.

User's message: Write the PR description for the webhook-retry branch. changes.md summarizes what changed.

assertions.text: The description opens with one or two sentences naming the return-type change as the part needing the reviewer's judgment and the renames as mechanical
The return-type change is surfaced as a deviation from the original ask, with the reason (callers need attempt counts)
The description body is at most 200 words
No markdown headers (terse label lines such as 'Risk:' are allowed)
Every concrete number and claim traces to changes.md or the source file (invented test contents or implementation details not in changes.md fail)
The chat text around the description is at most 60 words
